verdict.rationale: Modal documents programmatic creation and scaling of sandboxes to hundreds of thousands of concurrent environments, with a higher-throughput backend and SDKs (Python/JS/Go) for scripting operations across many sandboxes. Bulk work is therefore possible by fanning out through code, but there is no evidence of a dedicated bulk or batch API for acting on many items in one call. Missing for 10: explicit bulk/batch operation APIs (e.g. multi-sandbox exec/terminate/list-and-act), documentation of batch patterns, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
